05/ 15.05.2024: Nobody appeared on behalf of the petitioners.
Learned counsel for the State is present.

2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Mango P.S. Case No. 13 of 2018,
corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 174 of 2018, registered under sections 376 (2) (i), 376(D)
of the I.P.C. and under section 4 of POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-V- cum- Special Judge (POCSO) at Jamshedpur.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-V- cum- Special Judge (POCSO) at Jamshedpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. It is averred in the petition that the petitioners are not named in F.I.R and allegations are made against one Nanak Chandra Seth that the daughter of the informant was employed by Nanak Chandra Seth and she was happily residing there.
Later on, the said Nank Chandra Seth informed the informant that the relationship was established by any electrician with victim, who was residing near the house of the Nanak Chandra Seth.
It is further averred in the petition that several persons were made accused in that case and pursuant to that the matter was handed over to CID.
The CID has investigated the matter and submitted final form exonerating the accused persons and the same is pending before the learned court.
It is disclosed that co-accused persons have been provided privilege of anticipatory bail in A.B.A. No. 566 of 2024 and A.B.A. No. 774 of 2024.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer on the ground that the CID disclosure report is there.

However, the learned court has applied the jurisdiction under section 319 of Cr.P.C.
5.

Considering that the petitioners are not name in F.I.R. and co- accused persons have been provided privilege of anticipatory bail in the aforesaid A.B.As, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the above named petitioners are directed to surrender before the Amit Kumar Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142909474/
